award.competitiveness: Guaranteed once admitted — but admission is the bottleneck, with about 40 or fewer new international students per year against applications from around the world.
award.howToApply: Apply for admission; the funding follows admission automatically.
award.note: Berea’s international FAQ says all admitted international students receive financial aid and scholarships covering 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees each year; it describes no different terms for the first year and for later years. Students pay a one-off USD 2,200 deposit (usable for certain expenses over the four years; extra aid if it cannot be paid) and are encouraged to save from campus work for personal expenses. The cost page adds that from Fall 2027 Berea guarantees 100% of tuition, housing, food, fees and supplies without loans for all students. Health insurance and books are not listed separately.

detail.en: Berea charges no tuition to anyone and states it is the only U.S. college that funds 100% of its enrolled international students. Admitted international students receive aid covering tuition, housing, food and fees. The catch is scale: roughly forty new international students are admitted each year.
detail.ru: Berea ни с кого не берёт плату за обучение и заявляет, что это единственный колледж в США, полностью финансирующий всех своих иностранных студентов. Зачисленные иностранцы получают помощь, покрывающую обучение, жильё, питание и сборы. Подвох в масштабе: в год принимают всего около сорока новых иностранных студентов.

detail.en: Penn State’s first-year deadline page prints the Early Action materials date as 5 November 2026 (11:59 p.m. ET); the international page says international deadlines are the same as domestic ones. The page does not name the entry term, so 1 November is kept as a standing rule. After 1 November applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; 1 December is the recommended submission date.

detail.en: Clemson Accounting/Economics BS requires completion of Pre-Business courses and Clemson college GPA 2.0 for major admission; the separate 2026–27 change into Pre-Business has 12 Clemson credits and 2.5 college GPA. These are university progression rules, not Uzbek school GPA minima.

Это правила перехода внутри университета, не минимальные оценки узбекской школы.

detail.en: Coventry’s Uzbekistan requirements: the Diploma of Specialised Secondary Education (Shahodatnoma) with an overall average of 4.5 or above (grades of 4 in key subjects) AND a recognised foundation programme. So an Uzbek school or lyceum diploma alone does not give direct entry to Year 1; two or three years of a relevant degree at a listed university may allow Year 2 or top-up entry at the School’s discretion.
detail.ru: Требования Coventry для Узбекистана: диплом о среднем специальном образовании (Shahodatnoma) со средним баллом от 4.5 (оценки 4 по ключевым предметам) И признанная программа Foundation. Значит, один узбекский школьный или лицейский диплом не даёт прямого поступления на первый курс; два-три года профильного бакалавриата в вузе из списка могут позволить поступить на второй курс или top-up по решению школы.

detail.en: U of T publishes its schedules as a PDF report (dated 1 March 2026). The 2027–28 figures are labelled “for information only” and “subject to change”. Computer Science students pay the Arts & Science fee in year 1 and a higher programme fee later. The university suggests C$1,000–C$2,000 a year for books and supplies, and requires UHIP of international students.
detail.ru: U of T публикует расписания в PDF-отчёте (от 1 марта 2026). Суммы на 2027–28 помечены «только для информации» и «могут измениться». Студенты Computer Science на первом курсе платят тариф Arts & Science, позже — более высокий тариф программы. Университет советует закладывать C$1,000–C$2,000 в год на книги и материалы и требует от иностранцев страховку UHIP.

detail.en: Arts & Science also needs a supplementary application by 1 February 2027 (11:59 pm ET).
detail.ru: Для Arts & Science нужна ещё дополнительная заявка до 1 февраля 2027 (23:59 по восточному времени).

detail.en: The schedule says DRAFT: FEES MAY CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE. The table and paragraph disagree on UHIP; do not select one silently. A first-time Western One Card costs C$50 outside the table. First-entry tuition after year 1 has a maximum 4% annual increase under the Registrar’s stated conditions; second-entry programmes are outside that guarantee. No draft figure is used to promise budget sufficiency.
detail.ru: В таблице указано DRAFT: FEES MAY CHANGE WITHOUT NOTICE. Столбец и абзац расходятся по UHIP; нельзя молча выбирать одну сумму. Для впервые поступающих Western One Card стоит C$50 сверх таблицы. Рост first-entry tuition после первого года ограничен 4% в год при условиях Registrar; second-entry программы в гарантию не входят. Предварительные суммы не используются для обещания достаточного бюджета.

detail.en: Competitive C$120,000 award over four years; no full-cost coverage is inferred from the amount. The admissions timeline establishes the 11 February deadline for Fall 2027.
